email.subject: Create ALB 5xx alarm → SNS finova-ops-alerts
email.body:
Please add an alarm we do not have yet.

WHAT HAPPENED
We can see CPU alarms. We do not yet alert when the load balancer returns lots of 5xx.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. Open CloudWatch, Alarms, Create alarm.
2. Metric: AWS/ApplicationELB, HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count.
3. Threshold: greater than 10 for 5 minutes.
4. Notify SNS topic finova-ops-alerts.

DO NOT
Do not delete HighCPU-payments.

REPLY WITH
The metric, threshold 10, the 5 minute period, and SNS topic finova-ops-alerts.

— Arjun

steps.instruction: Confirm metric: ALB HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count (or sim equivalent).
Threshold >10 for 5 minutes; action SNS finova-ops-alerts.

reply.model_reply: Alarm plan: ALB 5xx count > 10 for 5 minutes → notify SNS finova-ops-alerts. — L1

debrief.english: Config replies must include metric, threshold, action.
